title: Edge Esmeralda model index
description: Public GLB files served by this app. Stable URLs you can fetch from any other agent, tool, or pipeline.

models.name: Vibey
models.description: The canonical Vibey 2.0 character. Small expressive robot, ~453 KB, fully rigged. This is the version that runs in /space, the memory garden, the gallery, and disco mode.
models.origin: Three.js example: "Robot Expressive" by Tomás Laulhé / Don McCurdy. CC0.

models.name: Expressive Vibey
models.description: The original/heavier Vibey model. ~12 MB. Higher poly, different aesthetic. We swapped to the lighter canonical Vibey for readability + perf, but this one is preserved if you want the chunkier look.

models.name: Edge Island
models.description: Floating sky island spawnable. Heavy (~272 MB) — only fetch when you actually need it.

models.name: Littlest Tokyo
models.description: Animated micro-city diorama, keyframed traffic + neon.

models.name: Iridescent Arc
models.description: The community-currency hero ornament on /coin. Half-torus arch with PBR iridescent shader — reads best when lit with a RoomEnvironment HDRI.
